emc_roles.basis: pad edge to pad edge: placement.legality.pad_rect + rect_gap, signed (negative = the pad boxes overlap) -- what rule_proximity measures for a declared row: each subject pad against the nearest partner pad on its own net

keep_away_gap.basis: derived default, not a declaration: twice route.py's --keep-away-free (1.5 mm), so the band reaches past the radius around each net's own pads that the router leaves unpriced. It flags a crystal set beside a switch node, and no same-face pair on the human layouts this repo tracks. The datasheet or the designer decides the real gap

emc_roles.keep_away_note: PROPOSALS, not declarations (#1253). Each rule keeps the switch nodes read here away from ONE crystal's or oscillator's clock nets, in route.py's --keep-away syntax, at a derived-default gap. `measured` is check_floorplan's own keep_away reading of that rule on this board, pad edge to pad edge, plan view. To declare one, paste its `brief_row` into the design brief's `keep_away` list: check_floorplan then grades it on the placement and route.py, route_diff.py and the GUI price it on the tracks. A side read as `candidate` was read off the nets because the part's pins carry no function; which nets are noisy or sensitive is the author's to confirm.
emc_roles.note: REPORT ONLY: no intent key is written. Each row is in the shape `proximity[]` reads (`ref`, `near`, `pads`) with `max_mm` left null: the limit is the author's, from the datasheet, and copying the measured gap into it would bless the current pose (#902). Legs are reported, never a loop area, which a self-crossing pad polygon can shrink while every leg grows (#1254).

sources.emc_roles: placement.emc_roles (#1254): roles read off PIN FUNCTIONS (SW/LX, VIN, PGND/GND; I/O or CH lines) and the role table (crystals); every leg pad edge to pad edge (legality.pad_rect + rect_gap), never a loop area; `unknown` where the pins carry no function; rows carry max_mm null -- the limit is the author's. `keep_away`: PROPOSED design-brief rules (#1253), each clock part's nets against the switch nodes, in route.py's --keep-away syntax (parsed and resolved by keep_away), at a derived default gap, measured by check_floorplan's own keep_away grade
sources.mating: which parts count as connectors: render_placement.connector_edge_facts. `edge` is the edge the mating face points at when the body names one (placement.mating, #1155), else the nearest, and `dist_mm` / `overhang_mm` measure to THAT edge; `nearest_*` always to the nearest. Both from the placement.body occupancy rect, because connector_edge_facts reads the placement state pad-box ladder and would put two geometries on one sheet
sources.pin_order: placement.pair_order.pair_metrics; a pair through per-leg series parts (#1251): the junctions of diff_xnet.find_ac_coupled_xnets, judged by pair_order.composed_pair_metrics
sources.role: placement.roles.infer_role, from footprint name, pins (pintype / pin function) and reference prefix; the board carries no datasheet or 3D-model field to cite
sources.serves: placement.groups tether election: the nearest cap owner on the cap's rail -- an IC (4+ copper pads, not a row) or a supply owner such as a 3-pad regulator (#1249)
